tradition_assertions.notes: Reviewed work/title crosswalk: the Church's numbered list and TAU's Ethiopic index both use Amos, and the TAU book page identifies the Ethiopic Book of Amos. This matches the work title only; Pereira's historical witness is not identified as the current EOTC printed edition and transcription accuracy/completeness remain unverified. British Library Add MS 16189's catalog lists the Twelve Prophets in this Ge'ez codex at folios 42v–64v and names a starting folio for each. This is manuscript-catalog evidence only; it does not verify a transcription, complete book boundaries, or identity with a particular current Church edition. Standard USFM title-candidate research readers are catalogued for Amos.
